description: GTIN hierarchy: GTIN-8/12/13/14 forms, GS1 prefix, packaging-level link — Takes up to 100 GTINs and, for an agent reconciling a product feed or order lines, validates each check digit, converts it to the 14-digit form, reads the indicator digit and GS1 Prefix (restricted-circulation, ISBN/ISSN range, coupon), and, when a parent GTIN is given, checks the two share one base item (the packaging-level link). It does not look up the brand owner, the product or the country of

parent.description: Another GTIN that should be a packaging level of the same base item (for example the case GTIN-14 of a consumer unit).

name: gtin-hierarchy
